answer_1.quote: We evaluate our pretrained checkpoints on SQL tasks following the UnifiedSKG framework. Specifically, for text-to-SQL benchmarking we evaluate on Spider without database row information and WikiSQL with row information, as well as conversational text-to-SQL datasets SPaRC and CoSQL, and in alignment with our bimodal objectives we also evaluate on SQL2Text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated SQL queries and natural language descriptions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model on each of the aforementioned datasets using the standard metrics for each task. ... For Spider ... we report Execution Match and Exact Match ... for SQL2Text ... BLEU.
